mentions.name: recvmail
mentions.description: This service provides a way for AI agents to receive email and complete email verification when signing up for online accounts.
mentions.problem: There was no good way for agents to sign up for accounts that require email verification, so the author built this to scratch that itch.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built https://recvmail.net to scratch my itch for a way for agents to sign up for accounts with email verification.
